A.question: Do official reuse conditions permit asserting that original Congress events can be republished as AI-derived ratings of identifiable politicians without special assessment?
A.estimand: minimum source attribution and lawful-purpose requirements, as contrasted with missing real-person scoring/privacy gate

B.H1: reusing primary public facts has conditional allowances but derived personal ratings need separate lawful assessment and non-endorsement
B.H0: public source availability automatically permits all downstream ratings
B.Hother: provider has source-specific exceptions and licenses

C.source: Congreso Aviso Legal and BOE Ley37/2007 art8 (current consolidated)
C.falsifier: explicit blanket permission for all individual valuations

D.method: documentary legal scope review, not legal advice
